c1.descriptionRaw: Diluc deals 15% more DMG to opponents whose HP is above 50%.
c1.name: Conviction

c2.descriptionRaw:
When Diluc takes DMG, his ATK increases by 10% and his ATK SPD increases by 5%. Lasts for 10s.
This effect can stack up to 3 times and can only occur once every 1.5s.
c2.name: Searing Ember

c3.descriptionRaw:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Searing Onslaught</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
c3.name: Fire and Steel

c4.descriptionRaw:
Casting <color=#FFD780FF>Searing Onslaught</color> in rhythm greatly increases damage dealt.
2s after casting <color=#FFD780FF>Searing Onslaught</color>, casting the next Searing Onslaught in the combo deals 40% additional DMG. This effect lasts for 2s.
c4.name: Flowing Flame

c5.descriptionRaw:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Dawn</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
c5.name: Phoenix, Harbinger of Dawn

c6.descriptionRaw:
After casting <color=#FFD780FF>Searing Onslaught</color>, the next 2 Normal Attacks within the next 6s will have their DMG and ATK SPD increased by 30%.
Additionally, Searing Onslaught will not interrupt the Normal Attack combo.
c6.name: Flaming Sword, Nemesis of the Dark

profile.description: The tycoon of a winery empire in Mondstadt, unmatched in every possible way.
profile.name: Diluc
profile.title: Dark Side of Dawn

combat1.descriptionRaw:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous slashes.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
combat1.name: Tempered Sword

combat2.descriptionRaw: Performs a forward slash that deals Pyro DMG. This skill can be consecutively used 3 times. Enters CD if not cast again within a short period. The slashes represent the values that Diluc holds dear: one for justice, one for courage, and one for duty.
combat2.name: Searing Onslaught

combat3.descriptionRaw: Releases intense flames to knock back nearby opponents, dealing Pyro DMG. The flames then converge into the weapon, summoning a Phoenix that flies forward and deals massive Pyro DMG to all opponents in its path. The Phoenix explodes upon reaching its destination, causing a large amount of AoE Pyro DMG. The searing flames that run down his blade cause it to be infused with Pyro. The only reason to walk in the darkness is to light it up. Behold, that fleeing light in the dead of night is the herald of the coming dawn.
combat3.name: Dawn

passive1.descriptionRaw: Diluc's Charged Attack Stamina Cost is decreased by 50%, and its duration is increased by 3s.
passive1.name: Relentless

passive2.descriptionRaw: The <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro Infusion</color> provided by <color=#FFD780FF>Dawn</color> lasts for 4s longer. Additionally, Diluc gains 20% <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG Bonus</color> during the duration of this effect.
passive2.name: Blessing of Phoenix

passive3.descriptionRaw: Refunds 15% of the ore used when crafting Claymore-type weapons.
passive3.name: Tradition of the Dawn Knight
